content: .{@-अष्टका@} .²1 the first or chief Aṣṭakā after the full moon; एकाष्टके सुप्रजसः सुवीरा <ls>Av. 3. 10. 5</ls>. .²2 the eighth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Māgha (on which a श्राद्ध is to be performed).
